name: Orusco de Tajuña (Spain)
description: Green field with a red band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Orusco de Tajuña (a lion, bars and a mountain).
history: Orusco de Tajuña adopted its arms and flag officially on 24 April 1989, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 23 June 1989; the flag is green, with a red bend edged yellow and the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.
